newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica to mantain increasing dividends policy.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to mantain increasing dividends policy.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica de Espana will maintain its policy of gradually increasing its dividends, chairman Juan Villalonga told a local newspaper.

"The company plans to go ahead with its policy of gradually increasing its dividends, given that profits continue to grow at the current rate," Villalonga told financial daily La Gaceta de Los Negocios in an interview published on Monday.
Referring to the group's 21 percent stake public offer, which opens today, the chairman said to expect from it an increase in the number of the company's shareholders by 200,000.
Villalonga added that although the company will lose its monopoly position in the telecommunications market, it will maintain a very important market share.
"Telefonica will have 80 percent of the market instead of the actual 100 percent but this market will be a bigger market," he said.
